name: Rizuhble's Belly Flop Danny
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: If you're getting poked out of lane. Sell it for Diviner's Kevlar.

items.name: High-Velocity Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Sharpshooter completes 4,000 souls on.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Sharpshooter completes 4.8k weapon in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 2 purchases

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k weapon tier, which Sharpshooter completes 3,200 souls on. Upgrade of High-Velocity Rounds (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (weapon): Sharpshooter completes 4.8k weapon in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k weapon tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 46% weapon damage.
items.legacy_note: Chimera's landing also scales with weapon damage.

items.name: Grit
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 8800 souls (~8.8 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Compress Cooldown, 4800 souls (~4.8 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.caption: Strix Salvo (135), Chimera Mk1 (132) clear its 80-damage trigger; Jettison Fuel stays under it.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.why: spirit investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Compress Cooldown, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and spirit is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Stamina Mastery, 5600 souls (~5.6 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 8,800-24,000 (levels 15-27). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Chimera Mk1 T3, Close The Deal T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Chimera Mk1, explosion damage) grows from 142 to 401. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Compress Cooldown, vitality 4.8k at Stamina Mastery.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 27 to Chimera Mk1's explosion damage (1.50x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Compress Cooldown completes 4.8k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Chimera Mk1: takes 18% off its 21s base cooldown.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.caption: Builds toward the 4.8k vitality tier, which Stamina Mastery completes 2,400 souls on. Upgrade of Grit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Stamina Mastery completes 4.8k vitality in 2400 souls (~2.4 min), 1 purchases

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (2,400 to 4,800 invested): bonus 15 to 38 vitality bonus. Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 6,400 invested: bonus 38 to 42 vitality bonus.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.caption: Chimera Mk1 (333) clears its 165-damage trigger; Jettison Fuel stays under it. Takes spirit from 4,800 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Burst (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.caption: Imbued on Chimera Mk1: +28 spirit on that ability only, about +42 on its explosion damage (1.50x scaling). Takes spirit from 7,200 to 10,400 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Strix Salvo range (21m), Chimera Mk1 radius (8m), Strix Salvo explosion radius (3.5m). Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,800 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power. Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 24,000-48,000 (levels 27-35). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Strix Salvo T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Chimera Mk1, explosion damage) grows from 401 to 559.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.caption: Casting Close The Deal gives a 1,000 barrier and +40 spirit for 20s, available once per ultimate cooldown (100s at your current ultimate tier), so it is a once-per-fight burst of defence. Takes vitality from 6,400 to 12,800 invested, crossing the 8k, 11.2k tiers: bonus 42 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power. | +30 spirit adds about 45 to Chimera Mk1's explosion damage (1.50x scaling).

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 148s; 20% off is 29.6s per full rotation.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 19,200 to 25,600 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power.

items.name: Indomitable
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 17,600 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Diviner's Kevlar? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.
sections.desc: Dying after Diviner's Kevlar? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Enchanter's Emblem.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: One gun hero is deleting you: Haze, Wraith, Vindicta.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun and Metal Skin isn't enough.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Knockdown before it lands, Slowing Hex, Disarming Hex.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is spirit: Seven, Infernus, Kelvin, Geist.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.caption: A stun cancels your Chimera Mk1 (channelled). Activate this before the stun lands (it cannot be used while stunned): 5.5s immune to stun, silence, sleep, root and disarm, 60s cooldown.
items.legacy_note: Stuns and silences keep stopping your dive.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 28,800 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: On the dive. Sell Greater Expansion for this.

items.name: Witchmail
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Focus Lens
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 25,600 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Silence them before the dive: part of the dive damage hits them again after. Sell Stamina Mastery for this.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
